nodes.name: Session vs Profile: Two-Layer Connection Addressing
nodes.summary: Decision documenting that Session (auto-registered Virtuoso process identity on a server, selects daemon port) and Profile (manually configured environment via VB_*_<profile> env vars, selects server + connection params) are orthogonal layers composing connection addressing. State files are profile-scoped; sessions are not. Examples: "--profile gpu1 --session eda-meow-3" targets the 3rd Virtuoso on the gpu1 server.

nodes.name: LLM-Assisted Inline Repair for Intermittent Netlist Issues
nodes.summary: Decision to use an LLM (instead of bespoke patch scripts) to read and fix intermittent netlist structural defects — e.g., rhrpo_3t_ckt resistors with 0 terminals, MOSFET instances missing (D G S B), BJTs missing (C B E). Driven by PDK-version/schematic-version variability. Justification: low frequency, structurally diverse, often new — script maintenance cost exceeds LLM call cost. Includes a prompt template with verification steps (model-file lookup, terminal-order discovery, subckt re-emission).

nodes.name: Standalone Spectre for One-Off Circuit Verification
nodes.summary: Decision to extract OA topology via SKILL (dbOpenCellViewByType + dbTraverseElements) and emit a topology-complete input.scs for standalone Spectre, instead of fighting ADE token / Maestro paths. Used for FT0001A_SH/CMOP/schematic (static comparator) — supports DC op, DC sweep, transient. Alternatives considered and rejected: ADE netlist (CMI-2116), -env ade +adespetkn=TOKEN (stale token), maeRunSimulation (modal blocks bridge 30s). Includes a SKILL topology-extraction template.

nodes.name: Defer version-specific code branches until API actually diverges
nodes.summary: Decision to remove speculative IC25/IC23 version branches from get_analyses and set_analysis (PR #4 review follow-up, 2026-04-20). Every get_analyses call was paying 2 SKILL RTTs for getVersion(t) + fallback even though is_ic25() always returned false — permanently unreachable dead code. Adopted lazy detection: client.version() called only inside the code path that needs it. Version infrastructure stays as scaffolding. Invalidation condition: a real IC25 API divergence confirmed by tests.

nodes.name: Maestro 仿真触发 API 在 IC23.1 上阻塞 bridge
nodes.summary: Decision documenting that on IC23.1, every Maestro API that triggers simulation (maeRunSimulation, maeCreateNetlist, asiCreateNetlist) blocks the SKILL bridge for 30s waiting for a GUI modal/progress bar. Read/write APIs (maeSetDesignVar, maeGetDesignVar, maeGetSessions, maeGetAnalysisType, hiGetCurrentWindow/cw->davSession, asiGetAnalogRunDir) are safe. Conclusion: Maestro automation in vcli is limited to set-var + session-info, then invoke standalone spectre. maeNetlistAndRun untested but presumed to block. Invalidation: IC25 introduces non-blocking run API.

nodes.name: Async Runtime Deferred — Use std::thread::scope for Concurrency
nodes.summary: Decision to defer adopting tokio in vcli (evaluated during si-view/via analysis on 2026-05-07). SKILL bridge is single-threaded per session, so async does not improve per-session throughput. The only parallel I/O opportunities are multiple independent session connections and TUI polling — both fit std::thread::scope (~40-line broadcast() implementation, no Arc, scoped borrows). Revisit only if vcli adds a persistent daemon-side connection pool or TUI latency becomes a real complaint. Future async conversion point: execute_skill.

nodes.name: Broadcast vs Subagent for Multi-Session Operations
nodes.summary: Decision defining when to use vcli skill broadcast vs Claude Code subagents for multi-session Virtuoso work. Use broadcast for: same SKILL expression across all sessions, minimal overhead (health checks, save-all, global queries). Use main+subagent when: tasks differ per session, multi-step reasoning needed per session, or per-session inputs diverge. Async/tokio rejected again (overkill). Both patterns compose: broadcast to survey, then targeted subagents only for sessions needing work. Relies on VB_SESSION=<id> env var prefix for per-process session isolation.
